sounds.prompt: A sharp hissing ignition CRACK as a bolt of fire is spat from a weapon, bright and spitting on the very first instant, with a short roaring flame body behind it that dies fast. The crack is the loudest part. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game flame projectile.
